description:
Enable `<:slot_name />` inside a component's own render/1 template.

## Changes

**lib/filament/tag_engine.ex**
- Add handler for `{:slot, slot_name, attrs, %{closing: :self}}` (self-closing form)
- Parse optional `default={Module}` attr from the slot render tag
- Emit vnode: `{:slot, slot_name, Map.get(assigns, slot_name, []), default_mod}`

**lib/filament/vnode.ex** — extend the `@type t` union:
```elixir
| {:slot, atom(), [Filament.Slot.Entry.t()], module() | nil}
#           ^name  ^entries from caller        ^default module
```

## Acceptance
- `<:header />` inside a defcomponent render/1 compiles and emits the new :slot vnode
- `<:footer default={AltFooter} />` passes the default module through
- The :slot vnode round-trips through inspect/logging without error
title: Tag engine: provider render site <:slot_name />
